info.cls_ename: Professional Master's Program of Graduate Institute of Financial and Economic Law
info.sub_name: 智慧財產權管理與授權

description.sub_name: 智慧財產權管理與授權
description.describe_ch: 結合法律理論與實務作法，以瞭解智慧財產權管理與授權相關議題。議題包括：智慧財產權取得與移轉、企業智慧財產權管理、智慧財產權授權、智慧財產權侵害救濟及智慧財產權鑑價與保險等。
description.describe_eh: This course is designed as a bridge course to connect real intellectual property management and licensing practice with legal theory. Major topics including the ownership and transfer of intellectual property, the legal aspect of corporate intellectual property management, the licensing of intellectual property, the infringement and remedy of intellectual property, and finally, the intellectual property insurance and valuation.

targets.describe_ch: 學生具備並能應用智慧財產權管理與授權專業知識。
targets.describe_en: Students possess understanding and ability to apply knowledge in relation to intellectual property management and licensing.

targets.describe_ch: 學生能對各種類的智慧財產加以描述，且應用不同的智財保護方法以適用之。
targets.describe_en: Students would be able to apply different IP protections based on characteristics of individual IP assets.

targets.describe_ch: 學生對授權行為和授權契約等智慧財產運用有的廣泛理解，並在分析比較後可提出適用的授權組合條件。
targets.describe_en: Students would be able to comprehend licensing and license agreement in IP laws, and through analysis and comparison would be able to propose a suitable licensing terms.
